title: Stop hunting for movers. They show up on your screen the moment they move
author: jtm_ind
selftext: You're not just tracking stock highs and lows — you're seeing them as they happen, in real time, and feeling the market's pulse before it becomes a blur. [HighLowTicker](https://highlowtick.com/reddit) gives you the speedometer of the session, so you can catch the first burst of new highs before the feed becomes a flood. Free tier is just the start — paid gives you the full tape, the custom lists, and the insight to know when to act.
